title: cluster-admin bound to a default service account
summary: A tutorial-style shortcut binds cluster-admin to default/default. Every pod in the default namespace that doesn't set a service account automatically runs with full control of the cluster.
notes: Pods use the namespace's 'default' service account unless they name another one, and its token is mounted automatically. A single compromised container then owns the cluster.
Fix: a dedicated service account per workload, a namespaced RoleBinding to the narrowest role, and automountServiceAccountToken: false where the API isn't needed.
Audit with: kubectl get clusterrolebindings -o wide | grep cluster-admin.
